_readme: SAMPLE FILE - the numbers are made up. Copy it, edit it, then upload it with 'Use my own JSON' or drop it in public/data/.
type: 'power' and 'water' get friendly labels; any other word (e.g. 'gas') also works and appears as its own rate type.
bands: list them lowest to highest, any number of bands. 'to' is the top of the band; the LAST band must use "to": null (no upper limit).
rate: price per unit in the currency's main unit (Rand, not cents): 324.12 c/kWh = 3.2412.
from: optional, only used for display. If left out it is worked out from the previous band's 'to'.
Optional: id, area, currency (default ZAR), effectiveFrom, notes, source, fixedMonthlyCharge, vatPercent, ratesIncludeVat (default true).
File naming suggestion: <country>-<area>-<type>.json, all lowercase with dashes, e.g. za-tshwane-power.json or za-cape-town-water.json.
notes: Example only. Not a real tariff.
